game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Royal Stables, the royal stables: the knight must hold off bandits while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Memory Map: Place variable cards on a memory board so the town gate reads the right value at run time.
theme: The Kingdom – Royal Stables: the royal stables
core_gameplay_loop: In Royal Stables, repeat each round: Place variable cards on a memory board so the town gate reads the right value at run time. Then check y and advance.
player_objective: Protect the town gate from bandits in Royal Stables: keep y above zero until the 76-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 9 (extended tier): Memory Map
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 1, Level 9, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
